Total token supply storage, mutated by Burn and Mint and read by totalSupply().

Public function requiring msg.sender == newOwner that finalizes ownership transfer.

onlyOwner function that increments a balance and the total supply.

edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership requires msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before taking ownership.
Burn is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
Mint is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller-controlled address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and passes msg.sender to the callback.
Constructor reads block.timestamp via now.
createdAt is assigned the miner-influenced block timestamp.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on the caller-supplied spender contract.
A malicious receiveApproval implementation can re-enter approveAndCall before it returns.
Reentrant callback executes while allowance state written by approveAndCall is still in flight.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
Burn decrements balances[_address].
Burn decrements _totalSupply.
Mint increments balances[_address].
Mint increments _totalSupply.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom moves balances between accounts.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
Constructor initializes balances for sales_account and company_reserve.
Constructor sets sales_account.
Constructor sets company_reserve.
transferOwnership writes newOwner.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
totalSupply() uses SafeMath.sub on _totalSupply.
transfer uses SafeMath.sub for balance debit.
Burn uses SafeMath.sub for balance and supply.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for balances and allowance.
transfer uses SafeMath.add for the credit.
Mint uses SafeMath.add for balance and supply.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for the destination credit.
_newOwner parameter flows into newOwner state assignment.
to parameter is the credit target of transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount moved by transfer.
_address parameter selects the Burn balance to decrement.
value parameter is the amount burned.
_address parameter selects the Mint balance to increment.
value parameter is the amount minted.
spender parameter keys the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens parameter is the approved amount.
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the allowance amount spent.
spender parameter is both the allowance key and the external callback target.
tokens parameter is the approved amount forwarded to the callback.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim to receiveApproval.
tokenOwner parameter is the balance lookup key.
tokenOwner parameter is the first allowance lookup key.
spender parameter is the second allowance lookup key.
tokenAddress parameter controls which contract is called externally.
tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external transfer.
